Creeps and Curses V.3.1

Special Grade Boon. When players reach level 20, they are generally expected to be capable enough to battle Special Grades. A GM can choose to give these players Special Grade Boons as rewards and power-ups to help in the battle against those nasty curses.

Once per round, you can activate any cursed technique as a free action. Additionally, any cursed technique you know that normally costs an action can now be used as a bonus action.
